spot.html_text: (the multiple realizability contention) (At least) some mental kinds are multiply realizable by distinct physical kinds. If a given mental kind is multiply realizable by distinct physical kinds, then it cannot be identical to any one (of those) specific physical kind. (the anti-identity thesis conclusion) (At least) some mental kinds are not identical to any one specific physical kind.
